title: Stuck and then rounded up in huge apartment complex/holding facility?
content: This is a kinda nuts one for me… but it also had a very intense feeling of fast-paced adventure. I Was in some sort of very very large apartment complex…only it wasn’t a normal housing complex, it was like a futuristic holding facility for young people (teens/early 20s) and it’s in a closed in shape (square or hexagons building with each floor facing the inner courtyard that is made up of two large swimming pools. Everyone suddenly ends up being chased through the complex (no one can escape) and hiding in their apartments or wherever they can while soldiers run around trying to collect and round people up and/or shoot them dead. I am running up and down different floors, hiding, trying to get away. Constantly running up and down these sets of staircases which are in each corner of the building. I slip into an apartment w an open door and see a bedroom with two twin beds, it’s a clean room..some toys/huge pillows on the floor and I instantly get under one of the beds trying g to hide and cover as much as myself with the pillow and bed that I can. A guard comes in and does find me and pulls me out and I instantly run away from him, run out of the apartment and I climb up over the guardrail of the balcony. I’m maybe 5 floors up. Lots of people are screaming and see me. I jump and do like 6 slips in the air and I’m above viewing myself from a distance and … it seems like I just miss the pool maybe by a little bit and hit pavement… everything goes black. My eyes open, and I’m under water(in the pool) and I see in the far corner at the bottom of the pool(in the deep end) there is a glowing egg, or orb… the size of a medicine ball or maybe twice that size and it’s glowing brightly under the water in purple and pink and blue electric energy. I swim up to it and touch it. Ext thing I know I’m floating face down at the surface of the pool and suddenly throw my head up out of the water gasping for air as two sets of hands grab under my arms to pull me out of the water. It’s a girl and guy I’m friends with. They say out loud to each other: “he’s alive! He found an egg/orb. (Everyone assumed he died in the pool..) then the girl says “yeah but too bad he only has 48 hours left now.” I had no idea what that meant … I wondered if the egg was going to do something to me in 48 hours? I couldn’t ask them cause that’s when I woke up. This is the second time I’ve seen this egg/orb thing in the mall world but I’ve never been explained what it meant. Also- I almost never have interactions (verbal or otherwise) with other people when I’m in mallworld.. usually I don’t even see others in the ‘scape I’m in. I remember feeling/thinking that the huge amount of people and interactions was really weird while I was in the dream. Also- when I woke up my eyes were super dry. They are back to normal now.
